title: PosMassScheduleOverride

id.description: The identifier of the mass override itself.

merchant_ids.description: The IDs of the merchants affected by this mass blackout.

items.description: The IDs of the merchants affected by this mass blackout.

start_time_utc.description: The date and time when this mass override begins in the UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) time zone.

end_time_utc.description: The date and time when this mass override ends in the UTC (Coordinated Universal Time) time zone.

start_time_local.description: The date and time when this mass override begins in the merchant's local time zone.

end_time_local.description: The date and time when this mass override ends in the merchant's local time zone.

description: Information about a blackout that applies to multiple merchants; used for groups of merchants to halt online orders or pause ordering during a disaster (Grubhub administrative use only).

name_filter.description: Optional Java Regular Expression used to target specific RepeatingSchedules by name

override_type.description: The type of a schedule override.  Describes whether the deviation is to open or close unexpectedly.

schedule_type.description: The type of mass schedule override, whether timezones are applied

updated_by.description: The last credential to update the schedule

created_date.description: The creation date of the schedule

updated_date.description: The last update date of the schedule

legacy_id.description: The legacy ID of the schedule in MySQL

MassScheduleOverrideMetadata.description: Metadata associated to a merchant mass schedule override
